title: Prison Reform De Carceration and Undertrial Rights Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing Bhim Singh directives for automatic bail for undertrials completing 1/3rd maximum sentence, 100% prison capacity cap, dignified prison labor wages, and Independent Board of Visitors inspections.
notes: Matter 026: Prison Reform De Carceration and Undertrial Rights Bill, 2026.
